preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 400.
Each test case must have n as a power of 2 between 4 and 2^16.
The value of k must be between 0 and n-1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not solution else len(solution) == n // 2
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output -1; otherwise, output n/2 pairs.

postconditions.expression: all(a_i & b_i for a_i, b_i in solution) == k
postconditions.description: The sum of the bitwise AND of all pairs must equal k.

postconditions.expression: all(a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in solution) and len(set(a_i for a_i, _ in solution).union(set(b_i for _, b_i in solution))) == n
postconditions.description: Each element must be used exactly once in the pairs.
